request.text:
labels: Tailored trousers divide into two separate leg tubes below the crotch, each with its own front crease and independent lower hem.; 재단한 슬랙스가 가랑이 아래에서 별도 다리통 둘로 갈라지고 각 통은 자신의 앞 다림질선과 별개 밑단을 갖는다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: Tailored trousers divide into two separate leg tubes below the crotch, each with its own front crease and independent lower hem.
aliases: 슬랙스의 두 다리통
